sources.provider: Wikisource 四部叢刊本 received transcription based on labelled Ming Zhengde exemplar
sources.url: https://zh.wikisource.org/zh-hant/宋學士文集_(四部叢刊本)/卷第十六
sources.quality_notes: Transcription labels 宋學士文集卷十六／鑾坡集卷六. Argument separates 三命 and 十一曜, retrospective Li Xuzhong / Xu Ziping line, historical Western astrology claim, 720x720=518400 and same-birth divergent-fate critique. Author composition not dated by existing printed edition; 1514 original physical leaf and 1551 variants not collated. Parallel 15BB Wen Tianxiang/Joseon received texts are not proved direct lineage nor modern calculation states.
